caption: Claude se bina editing software ke aise videos banao. Poora setup, start se end tak.
Step one. GitHub repo banao, Claude Code mein connect karo, aur bolo, setup chalao.
Setup khud install karta hai: Remotion, Whisper captions, free AI voice, aur SFX.
Step two. Reference video, A-roll aur voice over, apne folders mein daalo.
Step three. Claude reference ko frame by frame analyse karke, style aur topic samajhta hai.
Phir script, AI voice, aur har scene ka animation, sab khud banata hai.
Aur SFX, music ke saath, 1080p final render, sirf baarah minute mein.
Best part? Ye cloud mein bhi chalta hai, aur har naye session mein setup apne aap.
AI video editing seekhni hai? Toh follow kar lo.
